name: The Cliff
desc: A ridge along the far edge of the field. Slow going, but whoever stands on it sees far. Harpies nest on it.

name: The Waterfall
desc: Where the river comes off the cliff. Loud and wet: slow going and short sight. A serpent holds the pool.

name: The River
desc: The river from the waterfall to the near edge. Wading it is slow.

name: The Riverbank
desc: The strips of firm ground either side of the river.

name: The Cave
desc: A cave in the far corner. Dark: short sight, and anyone inside is hard to see. A bear sleeps in it.

name: The Glade
desc: A clearing in the forest around a spring. Standing in it heals.

name: The Forest
desc: The large wood on the west side. Slower going and short sight; anyone inside is hard to see. Wolves den in it.

name: The Deserted Village
desc: A deserted village on the east side: a smithy, a baker, a guard post and houses, each with something left behind.
